# ReviewFn

> Evidence-backed advisory pull request reviews, isolated execution, and report contracts.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Install ReviewFn and run a local advisory review.
- [ReviewFn](/docs) — Evidence-backed advisory pull request review.
- [Operations and limits](/docs/operations-and-limits) — Deployment gates, retention, and evidence boundaries.
- [Packages](/docs/packages) — Choose the ReviewFn package for each integration layer.
- [GitHub publication](/docs/publication) — Keep review execution separate from trusted advisory publishing.
- [Configuration contract](/docs/reference/configuration) — Versioned config, policy, adapter selection, and execution limits.
- [Evaluation contract](/docs/reference/evaluation) — Measure frozen cases and report comparison confounds.
- [GitHub Action and publication](/docs/reference/github-action) — Set up a credential-free review job and a separate trusted publisher.
- [Reference](/docs/reference) — Source-aligned ReviewFn contracts and operational guides.
- [Report schema](/docs/reference/report-schema) — Execution, coverage, verdict, assessments, evidence, and findings.
- [Security model](/docs/reference/security) — Trust boundaries, Docker containment, credentials, and retention.
- [Security and isolation](/docs/security) — Prepare the trusted runner, containers, credentials, and output boundary.
- [Review workflow](/docs/workflow) — Follow exact revisions from context capture to validated report.
